title: emg2pose: Surface EMG and Hand Pose
description: This dataset is a NEMAR re-host and EMG-BIDS conversion of the Meta emg2pose benchmark, comprising synchronized surface electromyography and hand pose recordings. It contains 2 kHz, 16-channel sEMG signals paired with hand pose labels derived from a 26-camera motion-capture rig, spanning 193 users, 370 hours, and approximately 80 million labeled frames across 29 behavioral stages. The dataset supports research on surface EMG-based hand pose estimation and human-computer interaction.
methods_description: EMG signals were recorded at 2 kHz across 16 channels from the wrist, synchronized with hand pose labels captured via a 26-camera motion-capture rig and represented as 20 radian-valued joint-angle channels. The original HDF5 recordings were converted to EMG-BIDS BDF format using a parallel adaptation of the facebookresearch/emg2pose PR #6 pipeline, with BAD_IK annotations marking samples where inverse-kinematics labels were invalid.
